subject.title: [Telegram] Bare URLs with & in query string rendered as & — link navigates to wrong destination

question: Which candidate fix should become the canonical implementation for the Telegram bare-URL ampersand bug?
rationale: Two open closing PRs target the same bug with different boundaries, and the final fix still needs real Telegram client proof before the issue can safely close.

options.title: Land a localized proven Telegram fix
options.body: Continue with the Telegram-local candidate or equivalent once it has redacted Telegram Desktop or mobile proof and no remaining formatter regressions.

options.title: Approve a shared renderer hook
options.body: Use the shared renderer approach only if maintainers intentionally accept the plugin-visible renderer contract and its nested-span semantics are fixed and covered.

options.title: Close candidates and queue a fresh repair
options.body: If neither current PR is acceptable, close or pause them and create one focused replacement fix with the issue context preserved.

recommendation.title: Land a localized proven Telegram fix
recommendation.body: Continue with the Telegram-local candidate or equivalent once it has redacted Telegram Desktop or mobile proof and no remaining formatter regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a Telegram visible-rendering bug, and this handle is listed for the Telegram subsystem with adjacent formatter history.
